summary: Enhance your skills in rural health policy and advocacy with our comprehensive training course. Join us to make a difference in underserved communities.
lede: Rural maternal and child health training helps frontline teams improve care from pregnancy through early childhood. Designed for nurses, midwives, community health workers and public health teams, it covers antenatal readiness, danger-sign response, newborn and child care, immunization follow-up, nutrition screening, referrals and documentation. Participants practice using checklists, follow-up workflows and quality-improvement cycles to address service gaps and strengthen continuity between facilities and communities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals dedicated to improving maternal and child health outcomes in rural settings.
audience: Nurses, midwives, clinical officers, and facility in-charges

prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of maternal and child health concepts, and experience working in or with rural health settings. Access to a reliable internet connection and a device for accessing course materials is essential.
